description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Mona Lisa.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mona Lisa, Science Geek
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
